name: Sungai Petani

queries.query: Sungai Petani Malaysia official cadastral parcel map GIS land office Kedah
queries.result: First-party results identified the Kuala Muda District and Land Office in Sungai Petani and an MBSP ArcGIS cadastral FeatureServer. The service description says it contains JUPEM-maintained national digital cadastral survey lots, based on GDM2000; live layer/query requests timed out from this environment.

queries.query: Sungai Petani peta kadaster lot tanah portal rasmi
queries.result: Malay-language first-party results identified JUPEM Kedah eKadaster and the national JUPEM eBiz digital cadastral-lot product. eKadaster is login/agency restricted; eBiz indicates cadastral products are purchased and does not provide an anonymous parcel feature response.

registryBasis: A local government land custodian is evidenced by the official Pejabat Daerah dan Tanah Kuala Muda page at 08000 Sungai Petani. The MBSP public GIS service is a local municipal map service whose cadastral description identifies JUPEM-maintained digital cadastral lots; it is a service route, not proof that all city parcels are anonymously queryable.

requests.outcome: ArcGIS REST service directory was discovered and publicly readable through first-party search/open evidence. It lists Lot Sementara, Lot Kadaster 2018, and Lot Kadaster 2009 layers, supports JSON queries, and states the cadastral data are based on GDM2000.
Direct anonymous metadata request attempted with TLS verification; connection timed out after 8 seconds. No layer schema, native identity field, or CRS response was captured locally.

Bounded anonymous point-radius query was attempted around the exact WUP point with geometry=true, outFields=*, inSR=4326, outSR=4326, distance=250 metres, and resultRecordCount=3. The host timed out before a response; this is not evidence of parcel absence.
Official JUPEM Kedah eKadaster login route discovered. No login, registration, credentials, or protected query was attempted.

Official JUPEM eBiz interactive product page was readable. It presents digital cadastral lots as a product/purchase workflow and displays a login boundary; no anonymous feature schema or parcel geometry response was retained.

safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier only when publicly returned and verified
unsafeFieldsNotRequested: tax, account, identity, or application fields

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: The MBSP service describes JUPEM-maintained national digital cadastral survey lots for Peninsular Malaysia and Federal Territories; local administrative evidence covers Kuala Muda/Sungai Petani.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Service directory and layer names were evidenced, but the live layer schema and bounded geometry response were not obtained due to timeout.

runtimeReadinessReason: Held pending independent serial qualification of a real adapter and verification of the live service schema, CRS, safe native parcel identity, and bounded geometry response. This packet is not source integration/admission.
remainingUncertainty: The public service appears to be a relevant cadastral route, but the exact layer fields, CRS details, query availability, parcel identity semantics, and citywide Sungai Petani coverage remain unverified from this environment. No exact-point hit or timeout was treated as citywide absence.
